clue.text: Twiggy, say, acting beside filming equipment held by European director (without US agent)

indicators.note: held by says the following pieces sit inside the trimmed name of the director
without says the agent's letters are taken out of the director's surname

parts.note: Ingmar Bergman, the Swedish film director
a G-man is an FBI agent in American slang
A is an abbreviation for acting, as in a military rank like A/Capt
by means beside, as in 'sit by me'
a boom is the long pole carrying a microphone on a film set

explanation.surface: Twiggy the model, at work beside cameras and microphones, gets taken in hand by a director from Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without US agent' trims the Swedish director's surname to three letters, and 'held by' puts the other pieces between its first letter and last two.
explanation.definitionFit: Twiggy was born in 1949, during the post-war surge in births, so she is an example of that generation.
